description: Rigorous PR pipeline for HIGH-STAKES changes: this distro's own merge-gate/safety-gate code, auth, migrations, concurrency/locking, anything touching money or secrets, or any change the operator is nervous about. Instead of two generalist review passes it fans the cold review out by dimension, then adds a behavioral verify gate that drives the changed behavior end to end. Select per task, not per repo (see the pr-workflow skill); when the stakes are ordinary use pr-pipeline.default.json. Tests still run and merge authority is unchanged (never merge red).

gates.note: dimension-parallel: one fresh reviewer per lens, each reads only the diff against base
apply the review findings on the same branch

behavioral gate: boot the app and drive the changed behavior end to end via bin/dm-verify.sh and the e2e-verification skill; screenshots are the evidence. Normally skipped only on the mechanical no-surface decision (dm-verify.sh gate --json answers decision=not-applicable)
auto-triggered: run bin/dm-pr.sh security-scan <id> --json; if its `surface` field is true run security-review, otherwise skip explicitly (never a silent forget)
open the PR with the branch convention and a short human description
